milestones.name: Offline, privacy, accessibility, and monetization promises

acceptance_criteria.evidence: AGENTS.md documents the fixed free-core/no-ads/no-tracking/offline-first monetization contract.
The committed app is an offline local game with no backend/account/tracking integration recorded; lib/main.dart states offline-first: no backend, account, ads, or tracking.
lib/ui/settings_screen.dart states the game runs entirely on-device with no account and no advertising.
Two accessible palettes, Warm and High contrast, are user-selectable and persisted through lib/data/local_store.dart.
The reduce-motion preference is additive only: it ORs with the platform disableAnimations flag, so user preference can add restraint but never remove the platform setting.
LinefallPalette.byName falls back to the default for unknown or corrupt stored values; this is covered by a test.
Stats are local counts only: per-opponent win/loss/draw records, no timestamps, no move logs, nothing identifying; pass-and-play is deliberately not recorded.
The daily puzzle has no countdown, no streak, no penalty for a wrong guess, and the correct answer still works after a wrong one; only solved days are stored and the list is bounded to 400 entries.
The daily puzzle is fully playable with no store at all, covered by a test, and is free with no gate or purchase prompt.
The premium_strategy_pack IAP and Restore Purchases flow are not implemented or verified.
Strategy lessons are still not implemented or verified.
No production store privacy disclosure or store metadata implementation was verified.
